nodes.long_description:
**NEW UPDATE**

Get ready to lace up in style—your new Hockey+ mansion just dropped!
This update brings a cozy, nostalgic twist to your mini hockey mayhem:

🔥 New Mansion Environment

Basement Rink: Underground games hit differently.

Deck Hockey: Bring the battle outdoors!

Garage Nets: Two nets right out front—perfect for those classic driveway shootouts.

Chalet Vibes: A warm, wood-trimmed cabin feel where hockey never sleeps.

🏟️ Still Includes 3 Full-Size Arenas
Compete solo or with friends in both competitive and casual modes, now with more variety than ever.

Whether you're ripping shots in the basement or recreating that golden-hour slapshot on the deck, this is the ultimate Canadian hockey dream.

Hockey+ VR is the biggest online hockey experience in the world—no joke, eh? Whether you're hitting the ice for intense 99-player lobbies or kicking back with friends in one of our many arenas, this game has everything a hockey fan could dream of and more.

And it doesn't stop there. Hockey+ VR immerses you in the vibe with live video feeds from Toronto, festive Christmas webcams, and a real-time hockey news feed to keep you in the loop. This isn’t just a game—it’s a celebration of hockey culture.

Whether you’re skating, passing, scoring, or just chilling with friends, Hockey+ VR is your ultimate hockey destination. Grab your stick, hit the ice, and give 'er, eh! It’s as Canadian as it gets.
nodes.short_description: Hockey+ VR is the ultimate online hockey experience! Play in massive 99-player lobbies across 2 rinks, 4 ministicks arenas, air hockey, chess, and more. Featuring live Toronto feeds, hockey news, and endless fun. Grab your stick and give 'er, eh!

Build 626: Private BETA goalie menu and comfort fade repair. Goalie equipment no longer blocks the drill menu ray, and the side panel faces the crease. Controlled Unity tests cover Back to the Frontend in all six drills using both controller rays, plus the ordinary Duel goalie pause-menu Leave/Confirm exit.

The comfort fade now fills the viewport in the tested wide, tall and off-centre views. Small continuous position corrections are less likely to flash the fade; deliberate relocations retain their separate render gates. Frontend startup and visible sign-in failure are checked separately. These scoped Editor tests and inspected renders do not establish physical Quest controller usability, perceived headset comfort, stereo/multiview or cold hardware startup.

Production uses the existing Meta/UGS startup services with Development OFF. Existing broader gameplay, online, performance and commercial-readiness limits remain recorded in the current build receipt. The exact signed APK and every required OBB from this same native build are verified for package/version, integrity and Unity GUID pairing. Private BETA draft only.

Build 624: Private BETA offline goalie repair. The local goalie outfit, pads, catcher and blocker are visible during the normal opening warmup and countdown, with consistent role-calibrated glove and blocker alignment into Live. Independently recovered left/right GP goalie paddles spawn beside the crease and use the existing Hurricane VR grip and dynamic physics. The original human goalie solver retains measured anatomy, head/wrist targets and grounded pad support during the tested head pitches. Opening presentation does not grant puck contact or canonical goalie coverage. The current receipt records the exact completed team-size, handedness, equipment and transition checks and inspected Unity scene images. Controlled Editor input does not establish physical Quest controller or headset acceptance.

The preceding Player / Equipment Locker, independent player-kit, original Green/Red stick-finish, puck-color and equipment-color choices, saved device-local preferences, and previews of the installed original models remain included. Worn Hurricane gloves, goalie equipment and the existing local player presentation use those choices. World-space menus block pointer hits across their visible backings and clear covered menu selection. Android EOS library registration runs through application Java before EOSSDK.init and native initialization, preserving the existing process lifetime and account/entitlement gates.

The current source also includes the later installed puck-assistance levels and Y/B release aim plus the scoped online physics, roomscale, equipment, animation and match-event repairs recorded in the current project handoff. Earlier native cohorts retain their exact dated scope; the current hand/ray checks do not establish new full-game, peer or hardware acceptance.

The prior shared twelve-section curved stick blade and authoritative sweep, faster human skating, layered ice, owned puck assistance and blade-face wrist-shot lift remain installed. Original arenas, authored assets and GUIDs, Hurricane VR/Final IK and the existing authoritative puck impulse owner are preserved. Player choices are kits on the installed body; puck choices change the installed original puck's color. These local appearance preferences do not grant paid content or synchronize another player's appearance.

Frontend and local offline play remain independent of network sign-in. Explicit online actions use player-hosted Unity Netcode with selected EOS P2P connectivity, lobby discovery and RTC voice, with real Meta sign-in and application-entitlement admission. Failed sign-in can retry from the server browser; active matches retain their admitted account identity. Free catalog access, local saved loadouts and unranked play are supported; trusted ranked result writes remain unavailable.

The current build receipt records the completed scoped checks, inspected renders and unresolved limits. Selected checks do not establish whole-game or commercial acceptance. Broader carry, pass, goalie, playground and saved-journey acceptance remains limited by the recorded earlier failures. Android EOS recovery, real Quest cold startup, physical controller/headset feel, stereo and audio, sustained performance, live Meta-to-EOS sign-in and two-account cross-network play/voice still require hardware/service acceptance. The exact signed APK and every required OBB from this same native build are verified for integrity, version and Unity GUID pairing. Private BETA draft only.
